---
title: The ncode CLI
description: A full-screen terminal session for ncode, on the same engine and database as the desktop app.
---

`{{cmd}}` opens a full-screen session in the current directory. See [Install](/docs/cli/install/)
and the [desktop app](/docs/desktop/).

## What it does

- Chat, plan and swarm runs, each with its own progress.
- Approvals you answer with one letter.
  - `y` once, `Y` this run.
